## Summary of Changes

Please provide a clear and concise summary of the changes made in this Pull Request.

- What problem does this solve?
- What package(s) are modified?

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement / refactor

## Quality Gate Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards.
- [ ] I have verified that all unit & integration tests pass (`bun test`).
- [ ] Strict TypeScript typechecking passes with zero errors (`bun run typecheck`).
- [ ] Performance benchmarks run cleanly (`bun run bench`).
- [ ] If applicable, I have added or updated unit tests to cover my changes.
- [ ] Release check passes (`bun run release:check`).
